conceptual_explanation: Level 5 Word Form Accuracy requires precision in formal vocabulary. You must distinguish between 'Affect' (Verb) and 'Effect' (Noun), and choose the correct negative prefixes for adjectives. Consistency in using academic suffixes (-ance, -ence, -ity) is also crucial for high-level writing.

rule_cards.name: Affect vs Effect
rule_cards.formula: Affect (Verb - to influence) / Effect (Noun - the result)
rule_cards.correct: The weather affects my mood. / The weather has a negative effect on my mood.

rule_cards.name: Negative Prefix Precision
rule_cards.formula: In- (formal), Un- (common), Im- (before p/m), Ir- (before r), Il- (before l)

rule_cards.name: Noun suffixes: -ance vs -ence
rule_cards.correct: The maintenance of the building is expensive.
rule_cards.incorrect: The maintenence of the building is expensive.

rule_cards.name: Verb vs Adjective: -en
rule_cards.correct: We need to shorten the presentation.
rule_cards.incorrect: We need to short the presentation.

head_noun_tasks.explanation: 'Irresponsible' uses the prefix 'ir-' because it starts with 'r'.
'Intelligence' is the noun form ending in -ence.
'Appearance' is the noun form ending in -ance.

drill_tasks.question: The rise in sea levels will have a significant ________ on coastal cities.
It is ________ to park your car in front of a fire hydrant.
The technician is responsible for the ________ of the server.
drill_tasks.explanation: Correct spelling of the noun form is 'maintenance'.

drill_tasks.question: Smoking can ________ your health in the long run.
drill_tasks.explanation: We need a verb form here (after 'can').

drill_tasks.question: His behavior was completely ________ and caused a lot of trouble.

boss_fight.paragraph: Climate change will effect every part of our lives. It is unresponsible to ignore the scientific data. We must ensure the maintainence of our natural resources for future generations.

errors.explanation: 'Affect' is the verb form meaning 'to influence'.
The correct negative prefix for 'responsible' is 'ir-'.
The correct spelling of the noun is 'maintenance'.

success_feedback: Stellar performance! You've mastered the tricky 'Affect/Effect' distinction and formal suffixes.
suggested_next_steps: Study adjectives with multiple possible suffixes (e.g., 'comparable' vs 'comparative').
